name: Graphite
summary: Code review platform for GitHub with stacked PRs, AI review and a merge queue.
description: Graphite is a code review platform for teams on GitHub. It supports stacked pull requests through its CLI and web app, provides AI reviews, a merge queue and insights. Cursor Cloud Agents are now integrated so users can create and ship changes from a pull request. A Hobby plan is free for personal repositories; Starter costs $20 and Team $40 per user per month, billed annually.

howToUse.title: Open Graphite
howToUse.description: Go to Graphite and choose Sign up or Get started for free, then sync the GitHub account as the page describes. It is a code review platform for teams on GitHub.

howToUse.title: Stack pull requests
howToUse.description: It supports stacked pull requests through its CLI and web app. Then use the AI reviews, the merge queue, and insights.

howToUse.title: Ship from the pull request
howToUse.description: Cursor Cloud Agents are integrated, so you can create and ship changes from a pull request. The homepage says you can do that without leaving the PR.

howToUse.title: Compare Hobby, Starter, and Team
howToUse.description: A Hobby plan is free for personal repositories. Starter costs $20 and Team $40 per user per month, billed annually.
